devdoc.details: The contract has no owner, operator withdrawal, token adapter, or mainnet switch.

claimRefund(bytes32).details: No Dojang re-check is required for recovery; identity revocation must not trap payer funds.

createJob(bytes32,bytes32,address,addres.details: The caller is always the payer. An evaluator is optional but, when set, must be independent.

openDispute(bytes32).details: APPROVED jobs remain disputable so a provider that cannot receive native ETH cannot trap funds.

releaseJob(bytes32).details: Any job participant may execute an already-authorized release; the destination cannot be changed.

resolveDispute(bytes32,bool).details: The independent evaluator is resolver when configured; otherwise the payer resolves the MVP dispute.

devdoc.title: XPAYR Verified AgentPay Escrow

approveJob(bytes32).notice: Records payer/evaluator approval. Approval never transfers funds by itself.

cancelJob(bytes32).notice: Cancels a job before submission. A funded cancellation must be claimed separately.

claimDisputeTimeoutRefund(bytes32).notice: Fail-safe refund if an evaluator never resolves an open dispute.

claimRefund(bytes32).notice: Returns cancelled or expired funds to the immutable payer.

createJob(bytes32,bytes32,address,addres.notice: Registers an immutable set of participants and an XPAYR policy decision.

fundJob(bytes32).notice: Locks native GIWA Sepolia test ETH for an existing job.

markExpired(bytes32).notice: Marks a non-terminal, unapproved job expired after its immutable deadline.

openDispute(bytes32).notice: Opens a dispute before release. No funds move at this transition.

releaseJob(bytes32).notice: Releases an approved job to its immutable provider.

resolveDispute(bytes32,bool).notice: Resolves a dispute to the provider or payer.

submitDeliverable(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Commits the provider's deliverable hash without placing its contents onchain.

userdoc.notice: A GIWA Sepolia-native, non-custodial escrow for policy-authorized AI agent jobs.
